signs.summary: {{words}} words · {{letters}} of {{total}} letters · {{ready}} ready to recognize

outputLanguage.label: Output and speech language
outputLanguage.hint: Language for recognised text and spoken output.

autoSpeak.label: Speak results automatically
autoSpeak.hint: When off, tap Speak to hear a result.

history.label: Save history on this phone
history.hint: Off by default. History never leaves this phone. Turning this off deletes saved history.

haptics.label: Vibrate when a sign is recognised

demoMode.label: Demo mode
demoMode.hint: Shows simulated results to demonstrate the app. It does not recognise real signs.

about.limitations: Sign → Text recognizes only the signs of its installed vocabulary. It has not yet been tested with many signers, and it shows “not sure” rather than guessing.
about.notInterpreter: This app is not a replacement for a qualified ISL interpreter, especially for medical, legal or emergency situations.
about.privacy: Camera video stays on your phone. It is never recorded or uploaded. Hand tracking runs on the phone; its files are downloaded once from Google's model server.
about.noVocabulary: No sign vocabulary is installed in this version.

theme.label: Appearance
theme.hint: System follows your phone's light or dark setting.

signs.hint: Teach the app the way you sign. Your recordings are stored only on this phone, as hand and arm positions.

modelError.title: Sign recognition stopped working
modelError.message: Something went wrong with the recognition model. Please try again.

permission.title: Camera access needed
permission.message: The camera is used to see the signer. Video stays on this phone. It is never recorded or uploaded.
permission.deniedMessage: To use Sign → Text, allow camera access for SignSpeak in your phone settings.

simulated.title: Demo mode: simulated results
simulated.message: These results do not come from the camera. This is not real sign recognition.

status.noSigner: No one in view. Keep your head, shoulders and hands in the frame.
status.uncertain: Not sure what was signed. Please try again.
status.noHands: Raise your hands into view to sign.

hints.low_confidence: Try signing a little more slowly, with hands clearly in view.
hints.ambiguous: It could be more than one sign.
hints.unknown_sign: This sign may not be in the app's vocabulary yet.

teach.a11y: Teach {{text}} the way you sign it

result.label: Last recognised
result.segmentHint: Make one sign at a time, then lower your hands.
result.emergency: Emergency-related sign. If someone needs urgent help, call 112.

transcript.label: So far
transcript.note: Signs in the order they were recognized. Fingerspelled letters are joined into words. This is not a translated sentence.

vocabulary.missingMessage: Sign → Text recognizes the signs of an installed sign vocabulary. No vocabulary is included in this version of the app yet.
vocabulary.language: Signs are shown in {{language}}, as in the dictionary.

speech.unsupported: No {{language}} voice is installed on this phone, so the text is only shown on screen. You can add a voice in your phone's text-to-speech settings.
speech.engineUnavailable: Speech is not available on this phone. The text is shown on screen.
speech.error: Could not speak. Please try again.

history.disabledMessage: Turn on “Save history on this phone” in Settings to keep recent results. History never leaves this phone.
history.emptyMessage: Recognised signs and phrases you look up will appear here.
history.privacyNote: Saved only on this phone. Demo mode results are never saved.
history.confirmMessage: This deletes all saved history on this phone. It cannot be undone.

textToIsl.subtitle: Type English words to see how they are signed.
textToIsl.inputLabel: Words or a sentence in English
textToIsl.placeholder: For example: Good morning, how are you?
textToIsl.unavailable: The recorded signs could not be loaded. Signs you have recorded on this phone can still be shown.
textToIsl.empty: Type a word or sentence first.
textToIsl.noSignBody: This word is not among the recorded signs, so it is left out.
textToIsl.missingBody: Left out: {{words}}. They are not among the recorded signs.
textToIsl.signsBody: Faded: where the hands start. Solid: where they end. Arrows: how they move. Tap a sign to play it there.
textToIsl.grammarNotice: Shown word by word in the order you typed. ISL has its own grammar and word order, and the face and body carry meaning too, so treat this as a guide, not a translation.
textToIsl.dictionaryHint: Choose a group to see its signs.
textToIsl.sourceBody: Each sign was recorded by Deaf students of St. Louis School for the Deaf, Chennai, for the INCLUDE dataset (AI4Bharat / IIT Madras, CC BY 4.0). One recording per sign is traced as hand and body points, so facial expressions are not shown, and now and then a finger may be out of place. Signs can differ between regions.

feedback.privacyWarning: Please do not include names, phone numbers, addresses or other personal details. No photos or video are sent.
feedback.included: App version {{version}}, {{platform}} {{os}}, app language {{appLanguage}}, output language {{outputLanguage}}.
feedback.sendHint: Sends this report over the internet to the project's server.
feedback.offline: No internet connection. The report was not sent. You can share it instead.
feedback.failed: The report could not be sent. You can share it instead.

diagram.a11y: Hand diagram of the sign for {{text}}
diagram.motionA11y: Moving hand and body diagram of the signs for: {{text}}

welcome.title: Welcome to SignSpeak
welcome.languagePrompt: First, choose the language for the app.
welcome.languageHint: You can change this any time in Settings.
welcome.appearanceHint: Light, dark, or follow your phone's setting.

intro.title: How it works
intro.subtitle: Three things to know before you start.
intro.signBody: Point the camera at someone signing. Signs from the app's sign vocabulary appear as text and can be spoken aloud.
intro.textTitle: Says when it is not sure
intro.textBody: If it cannot tell what was signed, it says so instead of guessing.
intro.privacyBody: Video never leaves your phone and is never saved. Hand tracking runs on the phone.

errors.camera_denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow camera access for SignSpeak (in a browser: the site settings), then try again.
errors.no_camera: No camera was found on this device.
errors.camera_in_use: Another app is using the camera. Close it, then try again.
errors.insecure_context: The camera only works on a secure (https) page.
errors.unsupported: This browser or phone cannot run hand tracking. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Safari.
errors.model_load_failed: Hand tracking could not be loaded. The first time, it needs an internet connection to download (about 25 MB).
errors.integrity_failed: The downloaded hand-tracking files failed a safety check and were not used. Please try again later.
errors.engine_stopped: Hand tracking stopped: the phone ran low on memory. Try again; it will use less.

teach.instructions: Keep your head, shoulders and hands in view. Press Record, wait for the countdown, sign once, then lower your hands.
teach.instructionsLetter: Keep your head, shoulders and hands in view. Press Record, wait for the countdown, then form the letter and hold it steady.
teach.different: This take looks quite different from your earlier ones. Keep it only if you signed the same sign.
teach.problemTitle: That take could not be used

problems.no_signer: No one was in view. Stand so your head and shoulders are inside the frame.
problems.no_hands: No hands were seen. Sign in front of your body, inside the frame.
problems.too_short: Hands were visible only briefly. Sign a little more slowly, keeping your hands in view.

teach.saveFailed: The take could not be saved. The phone may be low on storage.
teach.doneMessage: This sign can now be recognized in Sign → Text and shown in Text → ISL. More takes make recognition more reliable.
teach.doneLetter: This letter now appears in the alphabet and can be used to fingerspell.
teach.invalid: There is nothing to record here.

chooser.intro: Choose what the sign means, then record it three times. The best recordings come from someone who signs ISL fluently.
chooser.label: What does the sign mean?
chooser.noMatches: No common word matches. Teach it as a new word above.
chooser.vocabularyHint: Teach one the way you sign it, and the app will also recognize your version. Search among all {{count}}.
chooser.noVocabularyMatches: The app does not know this sign. Teach it as a new word above.
chooser.alphabetHint: Letter by letter, for fingerspelling names.
chooser.whoShouldRecord: Recordings made here are not checked by ISL educators. For signs others will learn from, ask a fluent signer to record them.

signs.title: My signs
signs.subtitle: Signs you taught the app. The more you teach, the better it understands the way you sign.
signs.privacy: Only hand and body positions are stored, on this phone. No video is saved, and nothing is uploaded unless you export your signs yourself.
signs.deleteAllMessage: This deletes every sign and letter you recorded on this phone. It cannot be undone.
signs.deleteTakeMessage: The recording is removed from this phone.
signs.readyMessage: This sign is recognized in Sign → Text and shown in Text → ISL.
signs.needsMoreMessage_one: Record {{count}} more take so this sign can be recognized.
signs.needsMoreMessage_other: Record {{count}} more takes so this sign can be recognized.
signs.deleteSignMessage: All takes of this sign are removed from this phone.

overview.emptyMessage: Record a sign a few times. The app then recognises it the way you sign it, including words it has never seen.

unfinished.title: Finish these
unfinished.description: One more take and these are recognised.

alphabet.title: Alphabet
alphabet.description: Your fingerspelling alphabet. Tap a letter to see it or to record it.
alphabet.sourceNotice: Letter diagrams are recordings made on this phone. The app does not ship verified ISL alphabet images yet, so ask a fluent ISL signer or teacher to record or check them.

export.title: Help improve SignSpeak
export.description: Your signs can help train a better model, especially words and signing styles that no public video has. Export them as a file and send it to the SignSpeak team, only if you want to.
export.confirmMessage: The file holds the hand and body points of each take and the words they mean. There is no video. You choose where it goes: the app sends nothing by itself.
export.failed: The file could not be made. Please try again.
